column1: # One optional module excluded at a time, isolating each module's own flash/RAM cost
# on top of the env's normal default build (see src/modules/Modules.cpp for the exact
# DeviceTelemetryModule has no dedicated exclude flag of its own (see Modules.cpp:220-221) -
# this is the combined cost of ALL telemetry (Device+Environment+AirQuality+Power), the only
# way to isolate it without a code change.
# NOTE: don't pair this with a -U of the same macro "to be safe" - PlatformIO/SCons buckets
# all -D flags before all -U flags in the final compile command regardless of the order you
# write them here, so a "-U... -D...=0" combo silently compiles as "define then undefine",
# leaving the header's own #ifndef default (1) in effect. A bare -D with no matching -U is
# unambiguous and doesn't hit this. (Verified via `pio run -v`.)
# Additive experiment (not an exclude): candidate linker flags from the flash-reduction plan,
# already used on STM32 (-ffunction-sections/-fdata-sections only, no matching
# -Wl,--gc-sections partner there) - measuring the full three-flag combination here.
